items.headline: TSMC Q3 profit up 68.7% on AI demand; Q4 revenue guided to $52.3-54.3B
items.why: High-performance computing was 68% of revenue and guidance implies about 58% annual growth, so AI chip demand is still accelerating at the foundry level even as gross margin slipped to 66.4% on the 2nm ramp.

sources.title: TSMC Q3 2026 Earnings Surpass Expectations, Profit Rises 68.7% (third-party repost; figures not checked against TSMC filings)

items.headline: Meta fell 9.4% after raising quarterly capex to $34.9B; Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon report this week
items.why: Hyperscaler spending is above $800B and Meta's negative free cash flow showed the market punishing AI outlays without matching returns, which sets the bar for the other three reports.

sources.title: Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta Earnings This Week Will Judge Whether $800B AI Capex Pays Off (summarizing Bloomberg)

items.headline: US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $635.6M net outflows on Oct 22, the largest single day since June
items.why: The outflow erased the prior day's $528.4M inflow and came with over $440M of leveraged liquidations, showing how fragile the ETF-driven bid is when equities sell off.

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs swing back to net outflows as $636 million in withdrawals erase previous day's inflows

items.headline: Bitcoin holds near $80,800 as 14,942 BTC leave exchanges, the biggest daily outflow in five weeks
items.why: Coins leaving exchanges reduce immediately sellable supply, but the source notes this alone does not prove accumulation, and price still failed to reclaim $82,000.

sources.title: Bitcoin price gains as 14,942 BTC leave exchanges ahead of Fed decision

items.headline: Fed holds at 3.75%-4% in a 10-2 vote, with two dissenters wanting a hike
items.why: The statement swapped 'raise' for 'maintain' and upgraded growth to 'strong', and traders price about an 84% chance of a December hike, so the next move is still up, not down.

sources.title: Rate decision live: Interest rates held steady in split vote (Yahoo Finance)

items.headline: September CPI ran 3.7% year over year while payrolls added only 29,000
items.why: Hot inflation alongside a weak labor market is the stagflation mix that makes the Fed's next hike harder to justify and harder to avoid; the 10-year yield sat at 5.02%.

sources.title: Fed preview: what to watch, October 2026

items.headline: US officials reportedly warned Gulf states to prepare for a 'short, intense' military campaign against Iran after the Nov 3 midterms
items.why: No strike has been announced, but a widening conflict is the main upside risk to oil and therefore to the inflation path the Fed is reacting to.

sources.title: Bitcoin price gains as 14,942 BTC leave exchanges ahead of Fed decision (cites a Wall Street Journal report)

items.headline: Brent near $114.68, about 61% above its pre-crisis level, with Hormuz tanker traffic near a standstill
items.why: Tanker transits were reported at 4 a day against a pre-war baseline of 85, so the price reflects a real physical supply cut, not just a risk premium.

sources.title: Iran says Hormuz can reopen in 4-5 days if US lifts blockade (figures mostly from secondary trackers, unverified)

items.headline: Iran extended its tanker blockade to the Gulf of Oman; Saudi loadings reportedly down over 70%
items.why: Reopening depends on a US-Iran deal that the latest talks did not produce, so oil stays exposed to headline risk in both directions.

sources.title: Iran says Hormuz can reopen in 4-5 days if US lifts blockade

items.headline: S&P 500 closed at a record 7,738.81 on Oct 28 on thin volume ahead of the Fed
items.why: The index is at fresh highs while the Dow and Nasdaq barely moved, so the breakout is narrow and leaves the next test to the post-Fed reaction.

sources.title: S&P 500 Closes at a Record 7,738 Ahead of the Fed Decision (the page's own framing of the decision timing conflicts with other reports)

items.headline: Bitcoin pinned under a resistance cluster at $81,600-$82,500, with support at $80,000 and $79,200-$79,500
items.why: The 20- and 50-day averages converge just under $82,000 and daily RSI is near 45, so a daily close above $82,500 is the level that would change the neutral structure.

sources.title: Bitcoin Price Before the Fed Decision: BTC Near $81,000
